# The storyboard kit, vendored

Release v0.1.0 of the storyboard kit, copied unedited from https://api.storyboards.sgit.ai/v0/v0.1/v0.1.0/ on 22 October 2026 by storyboard@php.newsroom, because no page on this site loads code from another host. `manifest.json` is the release's own manifest; the gate (`admin/build/validate.py`, check 4f) refuses any file here whose sha256 differs from it. To move to a new release, copy its folder beside this one and change `SB_KIT` in `admin/build/build.py`; never edit a file in a release folder.

Code Apache-2.0 (the kit), MIT (Rough.js, `vendor/rough-4.6.6.LICENSE.txt`), SIL OFL 1.1 (the fonts, `fonts/OFL-*.txt`). Docs: https://api.storyboards.sgit.ai/docs/index.html
